Image 1 is the APPROVED side (east) view and image 2 is the APPROVED rear (north) view of a creature sprite for the game RimWorld. Both are accepted art and the reference you must match.
Draw exactly this creature, the starmaw, a colossal space-whale-like sea beast, in the FRONT view: the creature faces straight toward the viewer, seen from directly in front, its gaping maw and eyes toward us.
This is a DERIVATION of the accepted views: the same figure, species and anatomy, the same proportions, the same palette and colour pattern, the same materials, the same thin soft slightly feathered keyline in a dark shade of the local body colour (not a black or navy ink line, never heavier or crisper than the approved views) and the same painterly rendering, so it reads as the same individual turned to face us.
CAMERA: the game's camera looks at the creature at about its own body height, only slightly raised. It is a front view, not an overhead one: the body comes straight toward the viewer and is strongly foreshortened, so the figure is about as wide and as tall as the approved rear view.
HEAD: the oversized gaping filter-feeding maw dominates the head, open as a huge intake, with the eyes toward the viewer. There is no whale-style head line and no blowhole.
TAIL: the tail is the vertical caudal fin seen in the side views, with its fork opening upper and lower. From the front it is foreshortened into a narrow upright blade rising behind the body, partly hidden by the body mass, and centred on the body's vertical axis. The silhouette's width comes from the body and the paired lateral fins, which sit in the same places as in the side and rear views and foreshorten and overlap the body.
BODY: dark hide densely spotted with point-like bioluminescent lights in star-field and constellation patterns across the broad back and flanks, so the creature reads as a patch of night sky rising from the water. Colossal ship-hull scale, a vast elongated mass.
Exactly ONE creature, centred, whole body visible, nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline.
